lead_headline: Restaurant tracker adds Snarf's Sandwiches in Montbello, TBirds closure in Wheat Ridge; subscribers log sixth straight negative day at −6.

restaurant.blurb: 1 opening, 1 closure — Snarf's Sandwiches debuts in Montbello (chain's summer expansion continues). TBirds bar & grill shutters in Wheat Ridge after multi-year run.

foreclosure.blurb: One $15M filing surfaces in Weld County this week — informational placeholder at ZIP 80634 tops recent foreclosure pipeline by 20x margin over next-highest Douglas County residential at $696K.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications filed Monday — extends weekend blackout to fourth consecutive filing day with no new permits, no status changes, no clearances. Seven-day window frozen at 271 total applications, all filed in concentrated Monday-Wednesday bursts last week following prior week's complete drought. August opening 10 days now show extreme volatility: complete filing freeze Thursday-Monday bracketed by compressed Wednesday activity spikes. Current 0-permit Monday baseline vs. typical 8-12 daily flow suggests industry hesitation or seasonal compression continues — pace now requires minimum 5-7 permits daily through month-end to approach historical August averages.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Monday — extends media blackout to full calendar week at 0 total mentions from 0 sources vs. prior week's 6. Six consecutive filing days without single citation establishes August opening week as unprecedented in tracking history — represents 100% collapse from typical 60-80 weekly baseline. No Instagram pickups, no local media, no trade coverage since late July. Year-to-date 1,167 total mentions from 111 sources remains frozen since Thursday with zero additions across weekend and Monday. Current trajectory projects first sub-10 weekly close in program history.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −6 yesterday (1 new, 7 canceled) — sixth consecutive negative day drives MTD to −22 (−2.2/day), though 90-day net holds at +67. Past week shows −22 net (18 new, 40 canceled) vs. prior week's +23 — complete reversal driven by 167% churn spike (40 vs. 15 canceled) overwhelming steady acquisition. Recent pattern: persistent cancellation pressure (7-day average: 5.7 canceled/day) now triple-strength vs. 2.6 new/day acquisition rate. August's −2.2/day MTD pace runs inverse to +0.9/day YTD baseline and marks steepest sustained decline in tracking window. Trajectory requires immediate +4-5 daily net through month-end to avoid first negative monthly close on record.
